bioprojects.title: Pleurotus eryngii (king oyster mushroom) genome assembly, gfPleEryn1 haplotype 1
Pleurotus eryngii (king oyster mushroom)
Darwin Tree of Life Project: Genome Data and Assemblies
Sanger Institute Tree of Life Programme: Data and Assemblies
Earth BioGenome Project (EBP)
The European Reference Genome Atlas (ERGA)

assembly_info.comments:
The assembly gfPleEryn1.hap1.1 is based on 466x PacBio data and Arima2 Hi-C data generated by the Darwin Tree of Life Project
(https://www.darwintreeoflife.org/). The assembly process included the following sequence of steps: initial PacBio assembly generation with Hifiasm in Hi-C integrated assembly mode, retained haplotig separation with purge_dups, and Hi-C based scaffolding with YaHS. The mitochondrial genome was assembled using OATK. Finally, each haplotype assembly was analysed and manually improved using TreeVal. Chromosome-scale scaffolds confirmed by the Hi-C data have been named in order of size.

assembly_info.comments:
The assembly gfPleOstr1.1 is based on 57x PacBio data and Arima2 Hi-C data generated by the Darwin Tree of Life Project
(https://www.darwintreeoflife.org/). The assembly process included the following sequence of steps: initial PacBio assembly generation with Hifiasm, retained haplotig separation with purge_dups, and Hi-C based scaffolding with YaHS. The mitochondrial genome was assembled using MitoHiFi. The mitochondrial linear plasmid MT2 was assembled using MBG. Finally, the primary assembly was analysed and manually improved using rapid curation. Chromosome-scale scaffolds confirmed by the Hi-C data have been named in order of size. There is a large heterozygous inversion on chromosome 5 from
569.3Kb-2.176Mb.

(https://www.darwintreeoflife.org/). The assembly process included the following sequence of steps: initial PacBio assembly generation with Hifiasm, retained haplotig separation with purge_dups, and Hi-C based scaffolding with YaHS.
